display.purpose: Prominent personal identity in the hero

narrative.overview: An open editorial layout with a prominent researcher name and biography, a featured AOEB publication followed by KaLM and LMEB, authentic source figures, a forest-green research band, and open engineering rows. Source Serif 4 carries the display voice while Source Sans 3 supports biographies, metadata, and links. Education includes master's studies advised by Prof. Meishan Zhang and undergraduate studies in Computer Science and Technology at HIT Shenzhen.
keyCharacteristics: A prominent researcher identity, followed by research evidence.
A lead paper, paired supporting papers, and open engineering rows.
Authentic figures with source attribution and full-size links.
dos: Do preserve authentic publication titles, author order, and attribution.
Do preserve complete source figures and maintain their provenance record.
Do use space, fine rules, and section backgrounds to establish content groups.
Do maintain visible focus and 44px resource targets.
donts: Don't turn the page into rounded SaaS cards or introduce purple gradients.
Don't add decorative motion, fabricated portraits, or unsupported research claims.
Don't infer undergraduate dates or a specific degree abbreviation.
